lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters arranged in roughly linear vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, with a higher spatial density of smaller spots in the anterior region near the pectoral fin attachment.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal alignment of blobs to form a grid-like pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges are visible running longitudinally along the upper third of the flank, displaying a sharp vertical intensity gradient with light-colored upper edges and shadowed lower edges.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of small, high-luminance blobs scattered irregularly across the visible surface of the first dorsal fin.

other_distinctive_markers: Two elongated dark pixel clusters are visible on the ventral surface posterior to the pectoral fin, indicating the presence of remoras.
